_doc: Offline window-state substitute for the budget oracle (E5-1 / #38). Under-cap case: 40000 of an 88000-token (Max5) 5h rolling window used -> fraction 0.4545. Set BUDGET_ORACLE_FIXTURE to this path so the oracle never reads ~/.claude or invokes claude-monitor in smoke. Reused by E5-3's over-cap variant.
